definition: Removing haze or fog artifacts from photographs to recover clear scene radiance, using atmospheric scattering models or learned priors.
details: Removing haze or fog artifacts from photographs to recover clear scene radiance, using atmospheric scattering models or learned priors.

explainer.lead: Image dehazing removes haze or fog artifacts from photographs to recover clear scene radiance, using atmospheric scattering models or learned priors. It matters for recovering visibility in hazy images.

tiers.eli5: It is like wiping fog off a window so you can see the scene clearly.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use atmospheric scattering models or learned priors; a pitfall is that the recovered radiance depends on assumptions about how the haze formed.
tiers.paperLevel: Removal of haze or fog artifacts to recover clear scene radiance, using atmospheric scattering models or learned priors.

explainer.example: A foggy landscape photo is processed with an atmospheric scattering model to recover clearer scene radiance.
